item.title: 30 km/h speed limit for minor residential streets in six Vancouver neighbourhoods begin this year
item.description: New signs posted in six Vancouver residential areas will reduce the speed limit of minor roads from 50 km/h to 30 km/h, starting in 2026.

item.title: Here's how to see the Blood Moon total lunar eclipse in Vancouver next week
item.description: Heads up, sky gazers! A total lunar eclipse will soon be visible over Vancouver, and we’ve got specifics on when you can see the Blood Moon.

item.description: Canadians who want to get more bang for their buck with groceries may want to consider credit cards that work best with their go-to stores.

item.title: 'Roles will be impacted': Electronic Arts announces layoffs from Burnaby-based studio
item.description: Electronic Arts (EA) has announced layoffs that have impacted a wide range of roles at Full Circle, the studio behind the popular game Skate.

item.description: Tyler Myers wasn't expected to be traded at the deadline, but recent reports suggest the veteran Canucks defenceman could be on the move.

item.title: U.S. ICE authorities will not be in Vancouver for the 2026 FIFA World Cup, says VPD chief
item.description: Vancouver Police chief Steve Rai says suggestions that U.S. ICE agents would be in the city for the FIFA World Cup amount to "fearmongering."

item.title: Vancouver City Council moves to triple road and sidewalk maintenance and repair budget to $104 million
item.description: Vancouver City Council is looking to triple the road and pedestrian sidewalk maintenance budget to $104 million over four years.

item.title: 'Welcome to Vancouver' entrance signs to be updated, dropping 'Olympic host city' text
item.description: The City of Vancouver is providing its "Welcome to Vancouver" entrance signs with a big update, removing "Olympic host city" text.
